findings.desc: packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:29 says Codex subagent prompts live in .Codex/agents, but packages/main/src/cli-init.ts:244 and docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md:126-147 both say thin asset mode uses the registry and may omit .Codex/agents. New init can therefore emit AGENTS.md text that misstates the generated asset shape in thin mode.

[HIGH] packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:192-198 and 642-646 still resolve only `koala` on PATH. Repro: run `lattice doctor --root <repo> --format=json` with a PATH that exposes `lattice` but not `koala`; the cliEntrypoint fact hard-fails with "`command -v koala` did not resolve a CLI executable" even though the primary `lattice` entrypoint is working. This breaks the new Lattice-first migration story and should resolve `lattice` first, then fall back to `koala`, with matching repair text/smoke coverage.

[HIGH] packages/main/src/core/runtime-environment-checks.ts:237-256 still hard-codes node_modules/.bin/koala inside checkProjectLocalBin, so doctor/runtime checks miss a shadowing node_modules/.bin/lattice even though F-002 requires lattice-first discovery with koala only as fallback. Repro: create node_modules/.bin/lattice plus a different active CLI; runtimeMode becomes diagnostic-only, but report.projectLocalBin incorrectly stays pass and points at a missing koala path. Fix: make checkProjectLocalBin use the same lattice-first candidate resolution as projectLocalBinPath/projectLocalBinCandidates and report whichever local binary actually shadows the active CLI.

[MEDIUM] packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:773-797 only covers a conflicting node_modules/.bin/koala path, so the new lattice-first runtime discovery contract has no smoke protecting the primary node_modules/.bin/lattice shadow case. That gap allowed the regression in checkProjectLocalBin to ship while build and runtime-fact-contract still passed. Fix: add the same conflict scenario for node_modules/.bin/lattice and ideally assert both lattice-primary and koala-fallback paths so doctor/runtime repair text is pinned to the new F-002 behavior.

AGENTS.md:189 and KOALA.md:61 still describe .Codex/agents as the Codex prompt location without the thin-mode caveat, even though this story explicitly requires F-001 and README/init templates already say thin mode can omit local prompt copies and rely on .Codex/lattice.json. The requested docs alignment is still incomplete.

packages/main/src/cli-prompts.ts:32, packages/main/src/handlers/story-create.ts:370, and packages/main/src/handlers/story-draft.ts:60 now document the background contract as English-only section headers, but cli-engine.ts, existing drafts, and the current repo docs still instruct the long-standing Chinese headings. This adds unrelated prompt/doc drift on top of the Lattice naming work.

packages/main/src/handlers/background.ts:103 Existing background.md files that still use legacy ## 触发事件-style headers cannot be appended anymore: the lookup compares raw header text to the canonical English title from backgroundSectionTitle(), so background_append now throws on repo data that packages/main/src/core/background-validator.ts explicitly accepts as compatible.
